entries.title: Cuphead
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with The Delicious Last Course DLC

primary.version: Cuphead with The Delicious Last Course DLC
primary.why: Cuphead released on Windows and Xbox One, then macOS, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and a limited Tesla Arcade version. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings flexibility, while The Delicious Last Course is available on Steam/GOG alongside console platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Use Cuphead on Windows through Steam or GOG with The Delicious Last Course installed. Use Tesla Arcade only as a novelty comparison because the sourced Tesla release only included limited content.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Delicious Last Course is DLC, not a standalone sequel. Tesla Arcade is not a complete play route.

entries.title: Mighty Cuphead Adventure

primary.platform: Unreleased - Sega Master System cartridge and modern platforms announced
primary.why: Studio MDHR officially announced Mighty Cuphead Adventure in June 2026 as an 8-bit action platformer built to Sega Master System specifications with a physical cartridge and modern-platform release planned. No final platform list, release date, or version differences are available yet.
primary.how_to_play: Do not archive a play route until Studio MDHR publishes final release platforms and the game ships.

entries.remaster_caveats: Pre-release title; revisit after platform/release details are final.
